Place the eight wave-9 Con(ZFC) Diophantine packages beside waves 5-8 (batch 225)

Arrival 0c6be9a074 ("Con(ZFC) in Diophantine form (wave-9)") delivered
eight archives, all pinned to the wave-8 placement beb0192cb8. Following
Vladimir's standing direction for this report, no earlier wave is
deleted: the packages land as sources 60-67 of
Computability/DiophantineConsistency/con-zfc-diophantine-forms, next to
waves 5-8 (31-59).

- 60-positive-gap           ConZFC_Positive_Gap_2026-10-23.zip
- 61-congruence-carriers    con-zfc-congruence-carriers.zip
- 62-sign-and-norm          con-zfc-sign-and-norm.zip
- 63-sign-recovery          con-zfc-sign-recovery-2026-10-23.zip

Each archive is extracted straight from the committed ZIP with its single
wrapper directory removed. Of 1,829 members, 1,030 are staged, 766 are
omitted as byte copies (up to line ends) of files already in the tree,
mostly earlier-wave sources, and 33 checksum ledgers and logs are
git-ignored. Licence, notice and attribution files are always kept. The
recovery map is appended to PLACEMENT.md as the batch-225 record.

All eight ZIPs are retired from docs/incoming. Nothing was edited or run.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Bind literal split116 source to unbounded nine-coordinate arithmetic

Check the authoritative old-z31-positive source, exact two invertible row
operations, permutation and all89 constant/linear/quadratic coefficient
records. Bind the literal three kernels to extracted channels over every
commutative ring, with exact degree ceilings, top coefficient1 and strict
2*Bcap*Kcap coefficient height. Preserve the sharp compact54 exponent.

Construct explicit cofinal power-of-two source witnesses, remove every
code-size premise, and prove the complete nine-natural-coordinate zero
existence iff with the literal22-row source. Only the original four port
boxes remain explicit in the compact54 theorem. The all-one source tuple
is excluded independently by row10=-7, supplying the positive outer code.
Document the full integer-polynomial register equation and witness domain.

Also prove the missing signed minus-form auxiliary Pell step-down and
safe strong quotient restoration. Recovered main classification, bootstrap
and half-modulus bounds stay explicit; no native calibration is assumed.

check files PASS, standard-axiom audits only; both source/kernel generators
byte-reproduce their emitted files. Counted-DAG identity, authentic native
compiler/K215 calibration and internal object-language ZFC iff remain open.

Assemble split116 source-carry contract and sharpen compact height

Connect low-digit recovery, signed-borrow high decoding, coefficient/degree
bounds, literal mask population and reduced-rank calibration. The assembled
binomial iff now derives all of those side conditions from the exact kernel
bounds, geometry and weak cap. Add natural/integer word and mask agreement,
unconditional high-word positivity, outer rank/threshold size bounds and
the free-carrier soundness/completeness adapters. Retain the exponent-zero
b=1 boundary and prove calibration without a parity restriction on kappa.

Generate a separate compact54-sharp instance with height2^864014,
radix floor2^864026 and threshold scale2^6912197. Factor the exceptional
transport coefficient as2*beta*(K0+1), check all89 actual coefficients,
replay four checkers and reproduce all69 files byte-for-byte under Python
3.12/3.13. The two previous instances stay byte-identical, replayed through
their authenticated checkpoint generator. This saves exactly one raw fixed
leaf byte; compressed size,473/480 operations and degree1,910,404 stay
unchanged. Independently audit all6 DAGs, fixed payloads and manifest seals.

PASS with standard axioms; sharp replay/rebuild controls PASS. Literal

Formalize split116 carry foundations and bind compact native tuples

Adopt two coherent instantiations of the wave-eight degree-separated,
free-carrier architecture. Replace all four native ports together with
package54/package57 tuples, regenerate the threshold and materialize every
live signed fixed leaf. Retain 473 positive operations and exact reported

Seal complete 68-file instances, provenance, adapted independent checkers,
byte-identical Python3.12/3.13 rebuild receipts and semantic rejection
controls. Add an independent DAG/manifest/fixed-byte reader.

Prove same-degree row extraction, the reduced central-binomial rank and
its exact population calibration, actual low/high mask populations, sparse
signed-borrow decoding, strict quarter-base coefficient bounds and the
free positive carrier ratio/finalizer adapter. Establish unconditional
source-word positivity before the weak cap and sharp packing bounds after
it. Include negative-layer, colliding-weight, carry-boundary and carrier
regressions with standard-axiom audits.

Lean check files PASS; independent four-DAG/constant/seal review PASS;

Retain byte-identical upstream license notices, including their trailing

con-zfc-diophantine-forms: README reconciling batch 224 (wave 8) beside waves 5-7

Adds the wave-8 section (sources 54-59) and a new combined frontier for
waves 5-8. The previous combined frontier moves into the wave-7 section
as "Frontier after wave 7, as placed".

Frontier after wave 8, as the packages state it:
- nine positive at degree 1,910,404 in 473 ops (59), the lowest degree
  and fewest operations at once, dominating every other nine-positive form;
- 10Z at degree 8,317,400 / 544 (57), or 513 ops at 25,838,224 (54);
- 13Z without Sun's preprint at 11,543,632 / 518 (59);
- twelve positive 242 / 94 and 258 / 89 (57); thirteen positive 132 / 83
  (57) and 126 / 91 (59); fourteen positive 52 / 79 (55 and 59, two
  different polynomials);
- fifteen positive down to degree 24 (58), with a 13-point Pareto
  frontier from 51's 157 / 66 to 58's 24 / 90;
- a 45Z quartic (57); smallest binding tuple 2^429959 (54, which itself
  calls the size "not a new record").

The figures come from three read-only intake dossiers that recounted every
operation count and measured degrees with their own evaluators (mod
2^127-1, actual fixed values). They also record which circuits coincide:
59's 44/76 reference is 49's offset44, 54 and 59 share two short circuits
on different tuples, and 55's and 59's fourteen-positive forms differ only
in their final sum. Tensions, delivery discrepancies (every driver fails
in place; ten-integer "degree_upper_bound" labels on exact degrees), and
further questions are listed per package.

Keeps the active research session's three edits from 94d84e5c1b, and
points at its PROPOSAL_REVIEW_WAVE8.md, which adopts 59's 473-op form as
its target. Nothing delivered was edited or run.

Assemble package 52 source, ratio and finalizer equivalences in nine natural coordinates

and exact integer casts for the masks, packed words and rank.

deriving its majorants, divisibility and margin requirements. Compose the

and finalizer in both directions. Export the complete nine-natural-coordinate
arithmetic source equivalence and its specialization under only the four
published native-port bit bounds. Literal multivariate-polynomial binding,
authentic-port calibration and internal ZFC derivation remain distinct.

Generalize the half-base convolution bound from 31 to any source dimension,
allowing a rounded power-of-two scale. This prepares a fully checked
compiler-based alternative to the still-unformalized native-window bridge.
